scope: Use frozen STScI 007 curves named by filter, with published columns 0.20 and 0.40 arcseconds for nominal 5 and 10 pixels. Score zero, same physical chip table, all UVIS2, and the published corner recommendation as a per-radius rule: UVIS1 table for r5 in the specified upper-left Amp A apertures; UVIS2 otherwise, including r10. Also measure the sensitivity of using the same table at the two radii in the Amp A corner. Verify each DETECTOR, FILTER, APERTURE and CCDCHIP by FITS hashes. Report per-visit and star/chip summaries without inferring independent calibration or WCS-sampling corrections.
